to_value.display_value: dorsal wrist, centered proximal to wrist crease

rationale: keep the pod close to the wrist axis and away from snag points
expected_effect: reduce snag and rotation risk during crowded transfer
risks: pressure, fit and sleeve clearance remain unverified
verification: measure displacement, rotation and skin pressure across wrist sizes and sleeves

to_value.display_value: broad vented strap with keyed clasp and intentional quick release

rationale: retain the device without a protruding clip while preserving removal
expected_effect: reduce slip and snag risk without making removal irreversible
risks: retention and breakaway behavior require prototype testing
verification: measure slip, rotation, one-hand release time and snag behavior

rationale: routine events must not expose private content in public space
expected_effect: preserve a private non-visual path without public audio
risks: detectability under carriage vibration is unknown
verification: measure detection and false-negative rate under vibration, clothing and sweat

to_value.display_value: guarded recessed one-handed press-hold; no response terminates routine event
